meta.note: Coordinates are point locations for settlements, taken from GeoNames. They are not BEL infrastructure locations. Entries with lat/lon null are streets, corridors, subdivisions and mile-markers that GeoNames does not carry; they stay in the file because the search box must still find them.
meta.disambiguation: Where a name exists in more than one district, the candidate in the feeder's own district wins. Records marked ambiguous_district_mismatch had no candidate in the right district and need review.
